summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed an 8-K regarding the issuance and sale of $1.1 billion aggregate principal amount of 5.125% Senior Notes due 2031. The placement was underwritten by Jefferies LLC and SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc. under a shelf registration statement. Proceeds (estimated net $1.087 billion) will be used for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary debt offering and not a special situation event.
